title: Local conditional step
statement: Let $D$ be a finite nonempty label set, let a constraint satisfaction instance have variable set $V$, and let a state consist of a marginal distribution on $D$ and a selected label in $D$ for each variable, together with a natural-number work count. For a variable $v\in V$, the local conditional step replaces its marginal by the point mass at a label maximizing the affected conditional count, updates its selected label to that same label, and increases the work count by the work of the step at $v$.
hypotheses_covered: State with marginal laws, assignment, and natural-number work count
